footnotes.english: Forsgren, Nicole, et al. (2018). Accelerate: The Science of Lean Software and DevOps: Building and Scaling High Performing Technology Organizations. IT Revolution.
footnotes.chinese: Forsgren，Nicole 等人（2018年）。《加速：精益软件与 DevOps 的科学——构建与扩展高绩效技术组织》。IT Revolution 出版。
footnotes.after: 大量已有研究已经证实，CI 对工程组织和整体业务都有益。

footnotes.english: This is also sometimes called “shifting left on testing.”
footnotes.chinese: 这有时也称为“测试左移”。
footnotes.after: 为了尽量降低缺陷的代价，CI 鼓励采用快速反馈回路。

footnotes.english: Head is the latest versioned code in our monorepo. In other workflows, this is also referred to as master, mainline, or trunk. Correspondingly, integrating at head is also known as trunk-based development.
footnotes.chinese: Head 是单体代码仓库中受版本控制的最新代码。在其他工作流中，也称为 master、mainline 或 trunk。相应地，在 head 上集成也称为主干开发。
footnotes.after: 持续构建（CB）集成 head 上的最新代码变更，并自动构建和测试。

footnotes.english: At Google, release automation is managed by a separate system from TAP. We won’t focus on how release automation assembles RCs, but if you’re interested, we do refer you to Site Reliability Engineering (O’Reilly) in which our release automation technology (a system called Rapid) is discussed in detail./
footnotes.chinese: 在谷歌，发布自动化由独立于 TAP 的系统管理。本章不着重介绍发布自动化如何组装 RC；有兴趣的读者可以参阅《网站可靠性工程》（O'Reilly），其中详细介绍了我们的发布自动化技术，即名为 Rapid 的系统。
footnotes.after: 由自动化流程创建、内部一致且可部署的单元，由通过持续构建的代码、配置及其他依赖组装而成。

footnotes.english: CD with experiments and feature flags is discussed further in Chapter 24.
footnotes.chinese: 第24章会进一步讨论如何结合实验和功能标志开展 CD。
footnotes.after: 事实上，许多场景下我们推荐使用动态配置，例如实验或功能标志。

footnotes.english: We call these “mid-air collisions” because the probability of it occurring is extremely low; however, when this does happen, the results can be quite surprising.
footnotes.chinese: 我们称之为“空中碰撞”，因为发生概率极低；不过，一旦发生，结果可能相当出人意料。
footnotes.englishAfter: That is, it is possible for two changes that touch completely different files to cause a test to fail.
footnotes.reason: The [^7] reference at line 188 is misplaced on selective Continuous Deployment. Its supplied definition explains mid-air collisions, whose actual English paragraph is line 240 and has no reference. Anchor by that meaning; the unrelated existing reference must not be used as the placement.

footnotes.english: Each team at Google configures a subset of its project’s tests to run on presubmit (versus post-submit). In reality, our continuous build actually optimizes some presubmit tests to be saved for post-submit, behind the scenes. We’ll further discuss this later on in this chapter.
footnotes.chinese: 谷歌各团队都会将项目测试的一个子集配置为提交前运行，其余留到提交后。实际上，持续构建还会在后台进行优化，将部分提交前测试推迟到提交后运行。本章稍后会进一步讨论。
footnotes.after: 谷歌大多数团队都会在提交前运行小型测试，例如单元测试。

footnotes.english: Aiming for 100% uptime is the wrong target. Pick something like 99.9% or 99.999% as a business or product trade-off, define and monitor your actual uptime, and use that “budget” as an input to how aggressively you’re willing to push risky releases.
footnotes.chinese: 将可用率目标定为100%并不合适。应根据业务或产品的权衡，选择99.9%或99.999%之类的目标，定义并监测实际可用率，再根据这份“预算”决定愿意多积极地推进有风险的发布。
footnotes.after: 监控与告警属于 SRE／生产管理领域，这个领域已经充分理解“错误预算”的理念；相比之下，CI 的思路仍倾向于追求绝对标准。

footnotes.english: We believe CI is actually critical to the software engineering ecosystem: a must-have, not a luxury. But that is not universally understood yet.
footnotes.chinese: 我们认为，CI 对软件工程生态系统至关重要，是必需品，而非奢侈品。不过，这一点尚未成为普遍共识。
footnotes.after: CI 则一直较多地被视为锦上添花的功能，这并不奇怪。

footnotes.english: In practice, it’s often difficult to make a completely sandboxed test environment, but the desired stability can be achieved by minimizing outside dependencies.
footnotes.chinese: 实践中，构建完全沙盒化的测试环境往往很难，但尽量减少外部依赖，就能达到所需的稳定性。
footnotes.after: 也就是在沙盒中启动整个软件栈。

footnotes.english: Any change to Google’s codebase can be rolled back with two clicks!
footnotes.chinese: 谷歌代码库中的任何变更，只需点击两次即可回滚！
footnotes.after: 因为它能迅速将系统恢复到已知正常的状态。

proseCodeBlocks.text: *Continuous Integration (2)*: the continuous assembling and testing of our entire complex and rapidly evolving ecosystem.
proseCodeBlocks.reason: Indented prose definition of CI, not executable code.

proseCodeBlocks.text: 持续集成（2）：持续组装和测试我们整个复杂且快速演进的生态系统。
proseCodeBlocks.reason: Chinese counterpart of the indented CI definition.

proseCodeBlocks.text: *Continuous Delivery* (CD): a continuous assembling of release candidates, followed by the promotion and testing of those candidates throughout a series of environments— sometimes reaching production and sometimes not.
proseCodeBlocks.reason: Indented prose definition of Continuous Delivery; preserves that candidates need not reach production.

proseCodeBlocks.text: *持续交付（CD）*：持续生成发布候选版本，再在一系列环境中逐步推进并测试它们；有些最终进入生产环境，有些不会。
proseCodeBlocks.reason: Chinese counterpart of the Continuous Delivery definition, not code.

proseCodeBlocks.text: *Hermetic tests*: tests run against a test environment (i.e., application servers and resources) that is entirely self-contained (i.e., no external dependencies like production backends).
proseCodeBlocks.reason: Indented prose definition of hermetic tests.

proseCodeBlocks.text: *封闭测试*：在完全自包含的测试环境（即应用服务器及其资源）中运行的测试；该环境没有生产后端之类的外部依赖。
proseCodeBlocks.reason: Chinese counterpart of the hermetic-test definition.

translations.english: Future improvement. This presents an interesting opportunity to try hermetic testing with record/replay in Takeout’s post-submit CI. In theory, this would eliminate failures from backend product APIs surfacing in Takeout’s CI, which would make the suite more stable and effective at catching failures in the last two hours of Takeout changes—which is its intended purpose.
translations.chinese: 未来的改进。这提供了一个值得尝试的机会：在 Takeout 的提交后 CI 中，通过录制／重放进行封闭测试。理论上，这能避免后端产品 API 的故障出现在 Takeout 的 CI 中，让测试套件更稳定，也更有效地发现 Takeout 最近两小时的变更引入的故障，而这正是这套 CI 的目的。
